datasets.name: discrepancies
queryLines: SELECT report_date, facility_id, cabinet_id, display_name, dea_schedule, discrepancies, resolved, unresolved, net_variance_units, median_hours_to_resolve FROM daily_discrepancies

datasets.name: compliance
queryLines: SELECT report_date, CAST(date_trunc('MONTH', report_date) AS DATE) AS report_month, facility_id, unit_id, flag_type, events, users FROM daily_compliance_events

datasets.name: below_par
queryLines: SELECT report_date, facility_id, unit_id, cabinet_id, drug_key, on_hand, restock_below, par_level, avg_daily_usage, days_on_hand FROM inventory_daily WHERE below_par AND report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM inventory_daily)

datasets.name: shortages
queryLines: SELECT as_of_date, facility_id, display_name, dea_schedule, shortage_records, array_join(availability, ', ') AS availability, latest_update_date, on_hand_units, avg_daily_usage, days_on_hand FROM shortage_exposure

datasets.name: review_list
queryLines: SELECT report_month, rank, user_id, facility_id, unit_id, shift, pulls, score, reasons FROM monthly_review_list

datasets.name: procurement
queryLines: SELECT report_month, facility_id, dea_schedule, display_name, restocked_units, est_spend, cost_source FROM procurement_monthly

datasets.name: quarantine
queryLines: SELECT file_date, rule, rows FROM quarantine_summary

lines:
## Controlled Substance Surveillance
**All data on this dashboard is synthetic.** It comes from a simulated two-hospital system (MAIN and COMM). No real patients, staff, or cabinets are shown.
Screening scores and flags are a review aid for pharmacy, not a finding of diversion. Patient IDs are hidden unless you are in the rx_privileged group, and you see only the facilities you have access to.

frame.title: Count discrepancies
frame.description: A blind count that did not match the cabinet's expected quantity. Unresolved ones need follow-up.

frame.title: On the FDA shortage list
frame.description: Days on hand counts cabinet stock only. Central pharmacy stock is not modeled.
